about_the_game:
DIG DEEPER. BUILD STRONGER. CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING.

Yaminer is a 2D voxel-pixel clicker game where your character mines forward through procedurally generated caves in search of valuable ores. Start with simple stone and unlock stronger materials like iron, gold, and beyond . Each new ore unlocks through shop progression, bringing new challenges and opportunities.

🪓 Upgrade and Enchant Your Tools

Progress through 100+ unique pickaxes, each with evolving designs every 10 levels. Upgrade your damage and break tougher blocks to dig faster and push deeper into new worlds. Enchant those pickaxes to get special buffs.

🛡️ Customize Your Loadout

Equip and mix helmets and full-body armors, each offering unique stat bonuses like:

  • Increased global income from specific ores

  • Boosted critical hit or double crit chances

  • Enhanced pickaxe damage and critical multipliers

You can re-equip any gear you've purchased, so you can make creative and optimized builds for different playstyles and ore types.

🌍 Explore Unique Worlds

Advance far enough, and you’ll unlock entirely new worlds, like The Hive, where stone is replaced by mycelium and spores take the place of traditional ores. Every world offers new visuals, upgrades, and a unique progression path.

🙏 Pledge to a God

Each world features three gods to pledge to, unlocking powerful, themed skill trees. Choose between gods that boost income, enhance damage, or support other builds. You can progress through multiple skill trees, but only one can be active per world — plan your builds wisely.

Yaminer is crafted from scratch by a solo developer, with all art and systems built manually. It blends the simplicity of a clicker with the depth of RPG-like stat building and long-term progression.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows Xp or later (64bit)
  • Processor: Dual core 2Ghz+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 3000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM (e.g. NVIDIA GeForce GTX 550 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 6770 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: Yaminer is a 2D voxel-pixel clicker about mining deeper, forging powerful pickaxes, unlocking ores, and optimizing gear builds through customizable helmets, armors, and skill trees. Explore worlds, unlock ores, get stronger and mine as much as you want.
